title: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid submits for review and approval by the Department of Public Utilities a Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Lowell Cogeneration Company Limited Partnership.
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. Also, the Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 09-GC-1)
